remarks: Positioned in one of Ellicottville’s fastest-growing areas, this is an outstanding opportunity to build your ideal getaway chalet, second home, or full-time residence surrounded by the natural beauty that defines this region. New chalet-style homes are rising throughout the area, reinforcing the long-term value and momentum along this corridor. Just minutes from HoliMont and Holiday Valley, and a short drive into the vibrant Village of Ellicottville, you’ll have immediate access to four-season living at its best—skiing, mountain biking, hiking, dining, shopping, and a lively nightlife scene that continues to expand with new restaurants opening. Seneca Allegany Resort & Casino is also nearby, offering year-round entertainment. The property itself is easy to build on, with electric and high-speed internet available at the road, making your vision that much easier to bring to life. If you’ve been looking for a setting that offers privacy, wooded surroundings, and close proximity to everything that makes Ellicottville one of Western New York’s premier destinations, this is a property worth serious consideration—priced to move and ready for your next chapter.
